subject: RohOnChain/MAXdeg0 public research configuration in HyperSmart
scope: Selected public research and monitoring workflows only

source_data_rights.rationale: No current entitlement evidence proves equivalence to Bloomberg data rights.

asset_coverage.rationale: The local observer covers selected crypto venues and assets, not Bloomberg's full universe.

event_news_coverage.rationale: Public alert adapters can represent selected events but no complete newswire parity is proven.

historical_depth.rationale: No controlled depth comparison against Bloomberg is available.

real_time_latency.rationale: HyperSmart measures local alert latency but has no Bloomberg latency parity evidence.

timestamp_quality.rationale: The canonical envelope separates source and local clocks, with source-dependent coverage.

provenance.rationale: Local events carry source URI and content hash; upstream source completeness varies.

corrections_retractions.rationale: The local ledger preserves corrections and retractions when supplied by adapters.

analytics.rationale: Local deterministic scoring and monitoring exist for a narrow research scope.

communications_network.rationale: No Bloomberg messaging or professional communications network equivalent exists.

execution_capabilities.rationale: HyperSmart is intentionally PAPER/READ-ONLY and cannot replace execution services.

reliability_sla.rationale: No comparable commercial SLA is available.

compliance_audit.rationale: Local append-only evidence exists but no enterprise compliance parity is claimed.

entitlements_permissions.rationale: Provider-specific entitlements are not proven equivalent.

export_api_capabilities.rationale: Canonical JSONL and projections are exportable within the local scope.

cost_tco.rationale: A controlled total-cost comparison has not been performed.

privacy_security.rationale: Local read-only controls exist, without a full product security parity assessment.

offline_local_path.rationale: Canonical replay and projections operate locally for already collected evidence.
